olivia (People Ops): Morning @daniel — saw your note about wanting to remove your father from medical since he enrolled in Medicare. We can do that as a dependent removal QLE but need proof of Medicare effective date. What docs do you have?
daniel ramos: Hey! He got Medicare Part A & B effective 2026-03-01. I have the award letter and a copy of his redacted Medicare card. Do you need anything else?
olivia (People Ops): The Medicare award or a copy of the Medicare card showing the effective date is usually enough. Carrier requires proof that he's now primary. Upload within 30 days of the QLE so we can process retro premium adjustments.
daniel ramos: If we remove him retro to 2026-03-01 will I get premium refund for April payroll that already deducted?
samir khan: Payroll note: If verification completes within the 30-day window and the effective date is 2026-03-01, we can do a retro adjustment back to that date which will show as a correction on the next payroll cycle + a separate refund line if needed. If verification is after 30 days, removal will usually start the next payroll period and retro refunds are unlikely.
daniel ramos: Ok — how do I upload securely? The Medicare letter has his full Medicare number.
benefits-bot: @daniel ramos Upload steps: 1) Sign in -> Benefits -> Manage Dependents -> Remove Dependent (QLE) -> Upload proof. 2) Choose document type: "Medicare enrollment/award letter". 3) If document contains a full Medicare number, toggle "Contains sensitive info" so it goes to the secure queue. Accepted formats: PDF, JPG, PNG. Max file size 10MB. Recommended filename: ramos_father_medicare_202603.pdf
daniel ramos: Done — I uploaded medicare_award_20260301.pdf and scanned_medcard_redacted.jpg, marked as sensitive. Also left a note with the preferred refund method (payroll refund).
hr-portal-bot: Files received. Case MR-2026-1245 opened. Verification ETA 2 business days. If carrier needs more info we'll follow up in this thread.
olivia (People Ops): Thanks @daniel — once verified we'll confirm removal effective date and payroll refund timeline. If the carrier pushes a denial, we'll help file an appeal. If you want confirmation for tax reporting, I can also pull the deduction adjustment note for your records. :thumbsup:
